editorial: Imagine being called into a bustling city where every corner is a new adventure. The film turns a familiar ensemble of pups into a lesson about courage, turning playful antics into surprisingly heartfelt moments. The fast-paced rescue scenes, synchronized to a lively soundtrack, create an exhilarating rhythm that keeps you glued to the screen. At times the pacing stalls a bit, especially between the second and third acts, but the brisk action eventually carries you forward. You will love it if you want a lighthearted, family-friendly romp that burns with bright animation and a dose of absurd humor.
targetAudience: Ideal for families seeking a brightly animated adventure that encourages teamwork.
